description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_CacheResource_File, which manages file system caching for Smarty templates, including methods for populating cache metadata, reading, writing, clearing cache, and handling locks.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_CacheResource_File
classes.description: Implements file system based caching resource for Smarty templates, providing methods for cache population, reading, writing, clearing, and lock management.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates cache object with metadata and file path based on template source and cache settings.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Updates cache object with the latest timestamp and existence status of the cache file.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads and processes the cached template file, optionally evaluating its content if update flag is set.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Writes rendered content to cache file and updates cache metadata; invalidates opcode cache if applicable.

methods.name: readCachedContent
methods.description: Reads cached template content from file.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all cache files for the Smarty object.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears cache for a specific resource, cache id, or compile id.

methods.name: hasLock
methods.description: Checks if the cache for a template is currently locked.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Locks the cache for a template to prevent simultaneous access.

methods.name: releaseLock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the cache for a template.
